components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lime-filled primary action; hover brightens and lifts.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--active); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--active); color: #172433; font: 600 14px Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s, background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #e2f886; background: #e2f886; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Surface-filled secondary action with a neutral border.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s, background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Icon Tool Button
components.description: Square surface control for theme and language tools.
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; width: 39px; height: 39px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 18px Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .18s, background .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-icon-button:hover { border-color: var(--cobalt); background: var(--soft); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: Compact filter with a dark selected state and cobalt hover cue.
components.css: .ds-category-filter { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 600 11px Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-category-filter span { color: inherit; font: 10px 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; opacity: .78; } .ds-category-filter:hover { border-color: var(--cobalt); color: var(--cobalt); } .ds-category-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: #fff; } .ds-category-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--coral); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Map Panel
components.description: Borded, softly elevated frame for the repository network map.
components.css: .ds-map-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--map-ground); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow); font-family: Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-map-panel header { display: flex; min-height: 50px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; padding: 0 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font: 600 15px 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-map-panel header small { color: var(--muted); font: 500 9px 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-map-panel-body { display: grid; min-height: 120px; place-items: center; color: var(--muted); font: 500 9px 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
Le Baron presents Jules’s public repositories as destinations in a compact, navigable atlas. The surface combines mineral paper tones, dark station-like headings, condensed display type, and small monospaced coordinates. Project artwork is generated from repository facts and CSS/SVG geometry; the map is a visual index that helps visitors explore the catalogue.

The interface supports French and English, light and dark themes, and the same project discovery, category, saved-match, and profile areas across screen sizes. A map route means only that projects share a category or programming language. It does not describe dependencies, imports, or technical relationships.
keyCharacteristics: A paper-and-ink base with bright route colors and a lime active state.
Condensed Barlow headlines paired with readable Barlow body copy and DM Mono metadata.
Repository facts shape the project map and CSS/SVG artwork.
Responsive, touch-ready project exploration with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Metadata Route Rule
rules.body: Route colors and connecting lines encode shared category or language only; never describe them as code dependencies or architecture.

rules.name: The Active Lime Rule
rules.body: Use lime to identify selection and primary action, keeping category identity with the route palette.

rules.name: The Three Register Rule
rules.body: Use condensed Barlow for hierarchy, Barlow for reading, and DM Mono for factual metadata and compact labels.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, chalk surface, and slate ink relationships in light mode; use the implemented dark theme mappings when a dark theme is needed.
Do keep repository category and language as the only semantics represented by map connections.
Do use Barlow Condensed for display hierarchy, Barlow for reading, and DM Mono for metadata.
Do retain the four-item bottom navigation and safe-area spacing at mobile sizes.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; the interface reduces animation and transition duration when requested.
donts: Don't call map connections dependencies, imports, or architecture; category/language sharing is their complete meaning.
Don't introduce raster artwork as if it were an existing portfolio asset; project visuals are currently composed in CSS/SVG from metadata.
Don't use the demo profile content as confirmed biographical claims; the interface marks it as sample material.
